response.sql: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS cross_region_mean FROM regional) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amount) AS mean_regional_average, AVG(r.transaction_count) AS mean_transaction_count, AVG(r.avg_amount - b.cross_region_mean) AS mean_excess_amount FROM regional AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.avg_amount > b.cross_region_mean;
